title: ChaosSMP
description: Official ChaosSMP modpack for the German ChaosSMP server
body:
# ChaosSMP

This modpack was developed specifically for the **German ChaosSMP server** – but it also works great as a standalone experience!

***

**‼️To join the ChaosSMP server, you must manually install [this mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-essentials/download/7209620) and [its dependency](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-library-forge/download/7182154) due to licensing restrictions‼️**

***

## Features

*   **New Biomes**: Over 100 beautifully designed biomes
*   **New Dimensions**: 10 additional Dimensions to explore
*   **New Structures**: 300+ Vanilla-style structures to explore
*   **New Mobs**: More than 250 unique creatures and [fish](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture)
*   **New Ores**: 260+ useful ores with matching gear and weapons
*   **Improved Performance**: Noticeably higher FPS and a much greater render distance
*   **Enhanced Graphics**: Optional high-quality shaders for a stunning visual upgrade

***

## Who is this modpack for?

This modpack is for:

*   Players who want to play on a **modded anarchy server**
*   Anyone looking for a **fresh**, **immersive**, and **optimized** Minecraft experience

***

## Common issues & solutions

### Poor performance

*   Open the modpack settings and **allocate more RAM** to Minecraft _(e.g. for 16 GB RAM → allocate 12 GB)_
*   In Minecraft, open **video settings**, click the **square icon** to the left of the FoV slider, and **lower the render distance and quality preset**.
*   Upgrade your PC

### Can’t join the server

*   Verify your **internet connection**
*   Ensure you haven’t installed any **unethical mods**
*   Confirm you're using the **latest version of the modpack**
*   **Wait a few minutes** and try again

***

## Need help?

If you encounter **bugs**, **issues**, or have any **questions**, please leave a comment or join the [official ChaosSMP Discord](https://discord.gg/H6ZFxhjYSJ).
